title: Section 10A literature vision mechanisms
description: Typed artifact contracts and mechanism hyperedges for 18 literature-derived vision, decomposition, saliency, and rendering-diagnostic census entries. The fragment records candidate semantic compatibility only and selects no architecture, binding, or runtime pipeline.

artifactTypes.label: Native opaque sRGB8 raster
artifactTypes.description: The once-decoded, native-dimension, three-channel opaque 8-bit sRGB raster with no resampling.

notes: Stable identity of the supplied encoded artwork image.
Stable identity of this exact native decode.
The native opaque contract admits only decodes with no alpha-bearing pixels.
Inspection paths expose source identity, decode identity, and the opaque success condition without changing raster topology.

sourceNotes: This is the fixed left product anchor and the NativeRaster output in research/v4/MECHANISMS.md:82-96.
provenanceNotes: Native dimensions, pixel order, source hash, and decode identity remain available through paired custody metadata.

artifactTypes.label: Pixel or region adjacency graph
artifactTypes.description: A graph whose vertices are source pixels or source-derived regions and whose edges encode declared local adjacency only.
sourceNotes: Required adjacency input for hierarchical constrained connectivity.
provenanceNotes: Vertex construction, neighborhood convention, and stable edge identity must be retained.

artifactTypes.label: Adjacency-edge dissimilarities
artifactTypes.description: Declared local dissimilarity values keyed to stable edges of a pixel or region adjacency graph.
sourceNotes: Section 10 names dissimilarity separately from adjacency and connectivity constraints.
provenanceNotes: Metric, scale, quantization, and tie behavior remain part of the value contract.

artifactTypes.label: Constrained-connectivity limits
artifactTypes.description: The local dissimilarity and global range constraints used to form a constrained-connectivity hierarchy.
sourceNotes: Both local and global constraints are load-bearing Section 10 inputs.
provenanceNotes: Units, inclusivity, scale policy, and revision must be explicit.

artifactTypes.label: Constrained-connectivity nested partitions
artifactTypes.description: A hierarchy of nested unlabeled partitions produced under local and global connectivity constraints.
sourceNotes: One permitted representation of the constrained-connectivity hierarchy.
provenanceNotes: Partition labels are structural identifiers and carry no field, figure, identity, or role semantics.

artifactTypes.label: Constrained-connectivity component tree
artifactTypes.description: A component-tree representation of an unlabeled constrained-connectivity hierarchy.
sourceNotes: Alternative representation named alongside nested partitions in Section 10.
provenanceNotes: Nodes and parentage encode hierarchy only, not semantic ownership.

artifactTypes.label: Constrained-connectivity threshold provenance
artifactTypes.description: A record linking hierarchy levels and component decisions to the effective local and global thresholds.
artifactTypes.intentionalTerminalPurpose: Preserves threshold and hierarchy provenance for audit; it is not an inference artifact.
sourceNotes: Threshold provenance is an explicit constrained-connectivity output.
provenanceNotes: Must identify the graph, dissimilarities, limits, ordering, and implementation revision.

artifactTypes.label: Stable ordered signed-affinity graph
artifactTypes.description: A graph edge stream with stable total ordering and declared attractive or repulsive affinity values.
sourceNotes: The sole compact-census input to mutex watershed.
provenanceNotes: Affinity source, equal-weight ordering, and stable edge IDs must be retained; learned and classical cues remain distinguishable.

artifactTypes.label: Mutex-watershed partition
artifactTypes.description: One unlabeled graph partition inferred from attractive and repulsive edges under mutex constraints.
sourceNotes: Section 10 specifies one partition without seeds or a partition threshold.
provenanceNotes: Segment IDs have no field, figure, identity, or UI-role meaning.

artifactTypes.label: Mutex-watershed constraints
artifactTypes.description: The accepted exclusion relations maintained while constructing a mutex-watershed partition.
sourceNotes: Mutex constraints are a distinct compact-census output.
provenanceNotes: Constraint endpoints must retain stable source-edge identity.

artifactTypes.label: Mutex-watershed edge-decision trace
artifactTypes.description: An ordered diagnostic trace of accepted, rejected, and mutex-blocked edge decisions.
artifactTypes.intentionalTerminalPurpose: Explains edge-order and tie sensitivity during research; it cannot assign segment semantics.
sourceNotes: Edge-decision trace is an explicit mutex-watershed output.
provenanceNotes: Must preserve edge order, weights, tie rule, and graph revision.

artifactTypes.label: Lifted-multicut base graph
artifactTypes.description: The local graph whose vertices and ordinary edges define the base decomposition domain.
sourceNotes: Base graph input named by the lifted-multicut census entry.
provenanceNotes: Vertex, edge, and local-cost identity must remain stable.

artifactTypes.label: Lifted nonlocal edges
artifactTypes.description: Long-range graph edges carrying declared must-join or must-cut evidence over a base graph.
sourceNotes: Lifted edges are distinct from the local base graph.
provenanceNotes: Every edge must retain endpoints, relation source, and confidence or cost provenance without claiming semantic correctness.

artifactTypes.label: Lifted-multicut costs and constraints
artifactTypes.description: The declared local/lifted costs, hard constraints, optimization tolerances, and bound policy.
sourceNotes: Costs and constraints are effective lifted-multicut inputs.
provenanceNotes: Currency, signs, hard/soft status, solver tolerances, and revision must be explicit.

artifactTypes.label: Lifted-multicut graph decompositions
artifactTypes.description: One or more unlabeled graph decompositions satisfying the declared local and lifted consistency conditions.
sourceNotes: The census permits one or more graph decompositions.
provenanceNotes: Component labels encode no field, figure, identity, or role semantics.

artifactTypes.label: Lifted-multicut objective and bound certificate
artifactTypes.description: A solver report containing objective value, available bound, gap, and exact/approximate status.
artifactTypes.intentionalTerminalPurpose: Reports optimization status and bounds; it is not evidence of semantic correctness.
sourceNotes: Objective/bound certificate is a distinct lifted-multicut output.
provenanceNotes: Must identify objective currency, solver, tolerances, termination reason, and input revisions.

artifactTypes.label: Lifted-multicut cut-edge provenance
artifactTypes.description: A record of local and lifted edges cut or joined in each returned decomposition.
artifactTypes.intentionalTerminalPurpose: Supports decomposition audit without adding semantic authority.
sourceNotes: Cut-edge provenance is an explicit lifted-multicut output.
provenanceNotes: Stable base and lifted edge IDs are required.

artifactTypes.label: TokenCut model-normalized raster
artifactTypes.description: The resized and model-normalized image tensor required by the cited TokenCut formulation.
sourceNotes: The census explicitly distinguishes this input from the native raster boundary.
provenanceNotes: Resize, crop, color conversion, normalization, and tensor-layout provenance are mandatory.

artifactTypes.label: TokenCut transformer patch-token grid
artifactTypes.description: Per-image pretrained-transformer patch tokens with explicit token-grid geometry.
sourceNotes: Pretrained transformer patch tokens are a required TokenCut input.
provenanceNotes: Model revision, layer, token selection, normalization, and grid-to-image transform must be retained.

artifactTypes.label: TokenCut DINO transformer revision
artifactTypes.description: The exact pretrained self-supervised transformer revision governing the supplied patch tokens.
sourceNotes: TokenCut's published claim depends on pretrained DINO token features.
provenanceNotes: Weights digest, architecture, source, license, and token-extraction revision are required; this port asserts no binding to a producer.

artifactTypes.label: TokenCut model pretraining-corpus identity
artifactTypes.description: Governance custody for the population and revision used to pretrain the supplied DINO transformer.
sourceNotes: Corpus identity is required to interpret a pretrained model's transfer claim.
provenanceNotes: This is provenance metadata, not permission to access training data during per-file inference.

artifactTypes.label: TokenCut normalized-cut eigenvector
artifactTypes.description: The selected normalized-cut eigenvector over the transformer token grid.
sourceNotes: Eigenvector is a distinct TokenCut output before bipartitioning.
provenanceNotes: Eigenproblem convention, selected vector, sign orientation, and tie handling must be retained.

artifactTypes.label: TokenCut token bipartition
artifactTypes.description: An unlabeled two-way partition of the model token grid produced by normalized cut.
sourceNotes: Bipartition is kept separate from its image-space mask projection.
provenanceNotes: Sides are structural until the TokenCut object-orientation rule is recorded; they confer no UI role or identity.

artifactTypes.label: TokenCut salient-object mask
artifactTypes.description: An image-space competing salient-object mask projected from a TokenCut bipartition.
sourceNotes: The mask represents TokenCut's salient-object prior, not a UI role assignment.
provenanceNotes: Projection, interpolation, polarity, threshold, and token-grid transform must be explicit; no field or identity authority is attached.

artifactTypes.label: TokenCut object score
artifactTypes.description: The scalar score attached to the selected TokenCut object-side hypothesis.
sourceNotes: Object score is a distinct TokenCut census output.
provenanceNotes: Score definition and calibration must remain model/revision scoped and do not establish treatment quality.

artifactTypes.label: TokenCut token-grid provenance
artifactTypes.description: A record of model, preprocessing, token-grid geometry, projection, and output calibration.
artifactTypes.intentionalTerminalPurpose: Audits the prohibited model/resampling path and does not enter product inference.
sourceNotes: Token-grid provenance is explicitly required by the TokenCut entry.
provenanceNotes: Must link image transform, model digest, token artifact, cut settings, and image-space projection.

artifactTypes.label: RTV spatial and regularization scales
artifactTypes.description: The spatial window, regularization, numerical, and stopping scales for relative total variation.
sourceNotes: Spatial and regularization scales determine what RTV treats as texture.
provenanceNotes: Values, units, boundary handling, solver revision, and stopping rule must be pinned.

artifactTypes.label: RTV smoothed structure image
artifactTypes.description: A synthesized structure-preserving smoothed image produced by relative total variation.
sourceNotes: Smoothed structure image is one of two distinct RTV outputs.
provenanceNotes: Synthesized pixels are evidence only and are not publishable source colors or semantic field labels.

artifactTypes.label: RTV texture residual
artifactTypes.description: The residual between the supplied image and the RTV structure reconstruction under a declared residual convention.
sourceNotes: Texture residual is distinct from the smoothed structure image.
provenanceNotes: Residual sign, range, channel space, and relation to the exact input must be retained; it is not a figure mask.

artifactTypes.label: Randomly initialized coupled Double-DIP networks
artifactTypes.description: The exact untrained coupled deep-image-prior network definitions, parameters, and random initial states used for one image.
sourceNotes: Random network initialization is an explicit Double-DIP input despite the absence of an external training corpus.
provenanceNotes: Architecture, parameter initialization, PRNG algorithm/state, precision, and framework revision are required.

artifactTypes.label: Double-DIP layer count
artifactTypes.description: The declared number of reconstructed layers and associated mask channels requested from Double-DIP.
sourceNotes: Number of layers is a load-bearing explicit input.
provenanceNotes: The count does not name or semantically label any layer.

artifactTypes.label: Double-DIP task hints
artifactTypes.description: Any task-specific hints or constraints supplied to resolve a particular single-image decomposition.
sourceNotes: The census states that hints are effective inputs, not incidental details.
provenanceNotes: Hint source, coordinates, values, semantic intent, and custody must be explicit; hints do not silently become output labels.

artifactTypes.label: Double-DIP task-specific losses
artifactTypes.description: The exact reconstruction, exclusion, and regularization losses and their effective coefficients.
sourceNotes: Task-specific reconstruction, exclusion, and regularization losses are explicit census inputs.
provenanceNotes: Formula revisions, reductions, weights, numerical precision, and schedules must be retained.

artifactTypes.label: Double-DIP stopping policy
artifactTypes.description: The iteration, convergence, early-stopping, checkpoint-selection, and timeout policy for per-image optimization.
sourceNotes: Stopping sensitivity is an explicit Double-DIP input and risk.
provenanceNotes: Iteration counts and selected checkpoint must be replayable from the optimization trace.

artifactTypes.label: Double-DIP unlabeled reconstructed layers
artifactTypes.description: Several synthesized image layers from a coupled single-image prior, without field, figure, identity, or role labels.
sourceNotes: The census explicitly says reconstructed layers remain unlabeled until a separate task interpretation.
provenanceNotes: Layer indices are optimization identities only; synthesized pixels are not exact-source publication values.

artifactTypes.label: Double-DIP unlabeled layer masks
artifactTypes.description: Several soft or hard decomposition masks paired with reconstructed layers, carrying no semantic polarity or role meaning.
sourceNotes: Masks are explicit Double-DIP outputs but are not unsupervised semantic labels.
provenanceNotes: Mask range, normalization, layer pairing, overlap policy, and checkpoint must be retained; no field/figure interpretation is attached.

artifactTypes.label: Double-DIP optimization trace
artifactTypes.description: A per-iteration trace of losses, regularizers, convergence observations, checkpoints, and stopping decision.
artifactTypes.intentionalTerminalPurpose: Diagnoses non-identifiability, randomness, and stopping sensitivity in research-only optimization.
sourceNotes: Optimization trace is an explicit Double-DIP output.
provenanceNotes: Must bind input, random initialization, losses, optimizer state, checkpoints, and stopping policy without asserting a runtime binding.

artifactTypes.label: Scalar field observations
artifactTypes.description: A scalar observation field over an image domain, with validity support and measurement-space definition.
sourceNotes: Alternative to image observations in the total-generalized-variation entry.
provenanceNotes: The term field describes mathematical domain only and conveys no compositional-ground or UI-role meaning.

artifactTypes.label: TGV first- and second-order weights
artifactTypes.description: The first-order and second-order regularization weights and numerical solver policy for total generalized variation.
sourceNotes: Both first- and second-order weights are explicit TGV inputs.
provenanceNotes: Weights, units, boundary conditions, solver, tolerances, and stopping policy must be pinned.

artifactTypes.label: TGV regularized field
artifactTypes.description: A synthesized piecewise-smooth regularized field estimated under second-order total generalized variation.
sourceNotes: Regularized field is a distinct TGV output.
provenanceNotes: This synthetic mathematical field is not source truth, a compositional-ground label, or a role artifact.

artifactTypes.label: TGV derivative fields
artifactTypes.description: One or more first- or second-order auxiliary derivative fields returned by the TGV formulation.
sourceNotes: Derivative fields are explicit and distinct from the regularized field.
provenanceNotes: Derivative order, discretization, axis convention, and relation to the regularized result must be retained.

artifactTypes.label: TGV observation residual
artifactTypes.description: The signed residual between supplied observations and the TGV regularized estimate in their declared measurement space.
sourceNotes: Residual is a distinct TGV output.
provenanceNotes: Residual sign, units, channels, support, and input relation must remain explicit; it carries no figure semantics.

artifactTypes.label: TGV convergence diagnostics
artifactTypes.description: Solver residuals, objective history, termination reason, iteration count, and null/no-field observations.
artifactTypes.intentionalTerminalPurpose: Reports unresolved solver and null/no-field behavior; it is not a field hypothesis.
sourceNotes: Convergence diagnostics are an explicit TGV output.
provenanceNotes: Must identify solver revision, precision, tolerances, and termination state.

artifactTypes.label: Graph trend-filtering signal
artifactTypes.description: A scalar signal keyed to stable vertices of an image-derived graph.
sourceNotes: The cited graph trend-filtering formulation is scalar.
provenanceNotes: Signal units, validity, vertex mapping, and any channel identity must be retained; independent channels are not a joint vector formulation.

artifactTypes.label: Graph incidence or higher-order difference operator
artifactTypes.description: The exact graph incidence or recursively constructed higher-order difference operator applied to a graph signal.
sourceNotes: Incidence/higher-order operator is an explicit graph trend-filtering input.
provenanceNotes: Graph revision, orientation, order, normalization, sparse layout, and boundary convention must be retained.

artifactTypes.label: Graph trend-filtering regularization
artifactTypes.description: The L1 regularization strength, trend order, solver tolerances, and stopping policy.
sourceNotes: Regularization is a load-bearing graph trend-filtering input.
provenanceNotes: A joint/group-norm penalty is outside this scalar contract and would require a separate artifact and claim.

artifactTypes.label: Graph trend-filtered signal
artifactTypes.description: The fitted locally adaptive piecewise-polynomial scalar signal over graph vertices.
sourceNotes: Fitted signal is a distinct graph trend-filtering output.
provenanceNotes: The fitted signal is synthetic scalar evidence and has no field/figure or role semantics.

artifactTypes.label: Graph trend-filtering sparse knots and edges
artifactTypes.description: The sparse graph locations at which the selected higher-order differences remain nonzero.
sourceNotes: Sparse knots/edges are an explicit graph trend-filtering output.
provenanceNotes: Knot support is channel- and operator-specific and carries no semantic boundary meaning.

artifactTypes.label: Graph trend-filtering residual
artifactTypes.description: The scalar residual between the input graph signal and its fitted signal.
sourceNotes: Residual is distinct from fitted signal and knot support.
provenanceNotes: Sign, units, support, and source/fitted revisions must be retained.

artifactTypes.label: Graph trend-filtering optimization status
artifactTypes.description: Objective, residual, iteration, convergence, and termination status for the scalar graph fit.
artifactTypes.intentionalTerminalPurpose: Reports optimization behavior without conferring semantic meaning on fitted knots or fields.
sourceNotes: Optimization status is an explicit graph trend-filtering output.
provenanceNotes: Must identify solver, precision, tolerances, stopping state, and input revisions.

artifactTypes.label: Soft predicted mask for topology loss
artifactTypes.description: A learned producer's soft mask prediction supplied for research-only topological comparison.
sourceNotes: Soft predicted mask is a required topology-loss input.
provenanceNotes: Producer/model revision, range, class channel, geometry, and preprocessing must be retained; the mask does not gain role authority.

artifactTypes.label: Reviewed target-topology specification
artifactTypes.description: A question-scoped reviewed target specifying required components, holes, or other persistent-homology constraints.
sourceNotes: Target topology is one permitted reviewed target input.
provenanceNotes: Reviewer, question, scope, class meaning, acceptance record, and exposure custody are required; it is prohibited from unsupervised runtime use.

artifactTypes.label: Reviewed target mask for topology loss
artifactTypes.description: A question-scoped reviewed target mask from which target persistent topology is computed.
sourceNotes: Target mask is the alternative to a direct target-topology specification.
provenanceNotes: Reviewer, image identity, geometry, class definition, uncertainty, acceptance, and exposure custody are required; it cannot enter cold inference.

artifactTypes.label: Differentiable topological loss
artifactTypes.description: The differentiable penalty comparing predicted-mask and reviewed-target persistent topology.
artifactTypes.intentionalTerminalPurpose: Research-only topology-training diagnostic; it is not a selector or semantic correctness measure.
sourceNotes: Differentiable topological loss is the primary scalar output.
provenanceNotes: Filtration, homology dimensions, target revision, reduction, and numerical implementation must be retained.

artifactTypes.label: Topology-loss persistence pairs
artifactTypes.description: Birth/death pairs and critical locations used to compute the topological discrepancy.
artifactTypes.intentionalTerminalPurpose: Explains the research-only topology loss without asserting correct geometry or semantics.
sourceNotes: Persistence pairs are a distinct topology-loss output.
provenanceNotes: Pair identity, filtration values, locations, homology dimensions, and target/prediction side must be retained.

artifactTypes.label: Topology-loss error attribution
artifactTypes.description: A diagnostic attribution of topological penalty to predicted components, holes, and critical pixels or cells.
artifactTypes.intentionalTerminalPurpose: Supports reviewed research diagnosis only and cannot authorize runtime segmentation.
sourceNotes: Error attribution is an explicit topology-loss output.
provenanceNotes: Must bind each attribution to persistence pairs, prediction, reviewed target, and loss revision.

artifactTypes.label: Finite archetypoids observation set
artifactTypes.description: A finite, ordered set of observations in the paper's standard normed feature setting.
sourceNotes: Finite observations in a normed feature setting are the archetypoids data input.
provenanceNotes: Observation identity, feature definition, scaling, order, and multiplicity policy must be retained; no population weighting is implied.

artifactTypes.label: Archetypoids cardinality
artifactTypes.description: The requested number of observed archetypal representatives.
sourceNotes: Cardinality is an explicit and answer-defining archetypoids input.
provenanceNotes: Requested count and any feasibility handling must be explicit.

artifactTypes.label: Archetypoids BUILD initialization
artifactTypes.description: The exact BUILD initialization choice, tie policy, and deterministic observation ordering used before SWAP.
sourceNotes: BUILD initialization is explicit because BUILD/SWAP reaches a local optimum.
provenanceNotes: Initial witness indices, tie rule, order, and implementation revision must be retained.

artifactTypes.label: Locally optimized archetypoids
artifactTypes.description: The selected observed exemplars after BUILD/SWAP local optimization.
sourceNotes: Outputs are observed data points rather than synthetic archetypes.
provenanceNotes: Selection as an exemplar does not establish role, support, semantic belonging, or population representativeness.

artifactTypes.label: Archetypoids mixture coefficients
artifactTypes.description: The coefficients reconstructing observations from the selected observed exemplars under the cited normed setting.
sourceNotes: Mixture coefficients are distinct from selected exemplars.
provenanceNotes: Matrix orientation, constraints, observation order, exemplar order, and precision must be retained.

artifactTypes.label: Archetypoids residual sum of squares
artifactTypes.description: The final residual sum of squares for the locally optimized archetypoids representation.
artifactTypes.intentionalTerminalPurpose: Reports local reconstruction fit and cannot select or authorize a palette role.
sourceNotes: Residual sum of squares is an explicit archetypoids output.
provenanceNotes: Feature scaling, norm, selected witnesses, coefficient revision, and precision must be retained.

artifactTypes.label: Archetypoids witness indices
artifactTypes.description: Stable indices linking every selected archetypoid to its exact input observation.
sourceNotes: Witness indices distinguish observed exemplars from synthetic means.
provenanceNotes: Indices must bind to the ordered observation-set digest and BUILD/SWAP revision.

artifactTypes.label: DeepGaze III model-normalized raster
artifactTypes.description: The resized and normalized image tensor required by the pinned DeepGaze III image network.
sourceNotes: DeepGaze III conflicts with the native-no-resampling boundary.
provenanceNotes: Resize, crop, color conversion, normalization, and tensor layout must be retained.

artifactTypes.label: DeepGaze III pretrained image network
artifactTypes.description: The exact pretrained image-feature network revision used by DeepGaze III.
sourceNotes: Pretrained image and scanpath networks are separate required inputs.
provenanceNotes: Weights digest, architecture, source, license, framework, and feature-layer revision are required.

artifactTypes.label: DeepGaze III pretrained scanpath network
artifactTypes.description: The exact pretrained fixation-history conditioning network revision used by DeepGaze III.
sourceNotes: The scanpath network is distinct from the image network.
provenanceNotes: Weights digest, architecture, history encoding, source, license, and framework revision are required.

artifactTypes.label: DeepGaze III previous-fixation history
artifactTypes.description: An ordered, possibly empty history of prior fixation coordinates and timing under a declared coordinate system.
sourceNotes: Previous fixations condition the next-fixation density; an empty history represents the first fixation.
provenanceNotes: Observer/session identity, coordinate transform, timing, censoring, and history order must be retained when present.

artifactTypes.label: DeepGaze III center-bias log-density
artifactTypes.description: The exact additive center-bias log-density artifact used by DeepGaze III before output normalization.
sourceNotes: The center bias is an effective additive input and must not be hidden as a default.
provenanceNotes: Artifact digest, training population, geometry, interpolation, units, and calibration revision are required.

artifactTypes.label: DeepGaze III fixation-corpus identity
artifactTypes.description: Governance custody for the natural-image free-viewing population used to fit and calibrate the pinned model artifacts.
sourceNotes: Population transfer is a load-bearing DeepGaze III risk.
provenanceNotes: Dataset/revision, population, task, split, exposure, and license are required; no training records enter per-file inference.

artifactTypes.label: DeepGaze III conditional next-fixation log-density
artifactTypes.description: A normalized conditional log-probability density for the next fixation, not an autoregressively sampled scanpath.
artifactTypes.intentionalTerminalPurpose: Research-only human-attention diagnostic; it cannot assign identity, field, figure, or treatment roles.
sourceNotes: The direct model output is one conditional density; scanpath sampling is a separate policy not encoded here.
provenanceNotes: Normalization domain, history, center bias, model revisions, preprocessing, calibration, and numerical precision must be retained.

artifactTypes.label: DeepGaze III inference provenance
artifactTypes.description: Model, center-bias, preprocessing, history, corpus, calibration, and output-normalization provenance.
artifactTypes.intentionalTerminalPurpose: Audits a prohibited warm-model diagnostic path and grants no product authority.
sourceNotes: The census requires model, center-bias, preprocessing, and calibration provenance.
provenanceNotes: Must bind exact input and artifact digests without asserting a producer/consumer binding.

artifactTypes.label: Registered rendered color image
artifactTypes.description: A rendered color image in a declared display encoding and pixel geometry, registered to its comparison counterpart.
sourceNotes: S-CIELAB requires two registered rendered images.
provenanceNotes: Rendering revision, encoding, dimensions, alignment transform, alpha treatment, and source identity must be retained.

artifactTypes.label: S-CIELAB viewing and display parameters
artifactTypes.description: The declared viewing distance, pixel density, display calibration, white point, and color-conversion assumptions.
sourceNotes: Viewing/display parameters are effective S-CIELAB inputs.
provenanceNotes: Physical units, calibration source, observer assumptions, and revision must be pinned.

artifactTypes.label: S-CIELAB spatial filters
artifactTypes.description: The exact opponent-channel spatial filter kernels, boundary handling, and sampling convention.
sourceNotes: Spatial filters are a separate explicit S-CIELAB input.
provenanceNotes: Kernel coefficients, support, normalization, channel assignment, convolution, and edge policy must be retained.

artifactTypes.label: S-CIELAB spatial difference map
artifactTypes.description: A registered per-pixel spatially filtered CIELAB difference map under declared viewing assumptions.
artifactTypes.intentionalTerminalPurpose: Diagnostic-only rendition-difference map; it is not a palette-semantic or treatment selector.
sourceNotes: Spatial difference map is the primary S-CIELAB output.
provenanceNotes: Must bind both registered renderings, filters, viewing/display parameters, conversion, and implementation revision.

artifactTypes.label: S-CIELAB difference summary distribution
artifactTypes.description: A declared distributional summary of values in an S-CIELAB spatial difference map.
artifactTypes.intentionalTerminalPurpose: Diagnostic-only rendition summary; low difference does not authorize semantic equivalence.
sourceNotes: Summary distribution is distinct from the full S-CIELAB map.
provenanceNotes: Statistic definitions, weighting, exclusions, quantiles/bins, and source-map digest must be retained.

artifactTypes.label: Rendered field image for CAMBI
artifactTypes.description: A rendered field or gradient image presented to the no-reference CAMBI diagnostic.
sourceNotes: CAMBI consumes a rendered field image, not a source-field role claim.
provenanceNotes: Render dimensions, encoding, gradient implementation, stop definitions, dithering, and display transform must be retained.

artifactTypes.label: CAMBI display and scale assumptions
artifactTypes.description: The declared display, contrast, viewing, spatial-scale, bit-depth, and multiscale-analysis assumptions.
sourceNotes: Display/scale assumptions are explicit CAMBI inputs.
provenanceNotes: Scale pyramid, contrast thresholds, display transfer, bit depth, and implementation revision must be pinned.

artifactTypes.label: CAMBI multiscale banding maps
artifactTypes.description: One or more spatial maps of contrast-aware contour-banding evidence at declared scales.
artifactTypes.intentionalTerminalPurpose: Diagnostic-only banding evidence; it cannot decide whether a gradient belongs or authorize a stop.
sourceNotes: Banding map across scales is distinct from the aggregate CAMBI index.
provenanceNotes: Scale, render size, dithering state, thresholds, support, and source rendering must be retained.

artifactTypes.label: CAMBI banding index
artifactTypes.description: The aggregate contrast-aware multiscale banding index for a rendered field image.
artifactTypes.intentionalTerminalPurpose: Diagnostic-only transferred quality index; it is not a gradient, stop, or treatment selector.
sourceNotes: The index is a distinct CAMBI output and its transfer to UI gradients is unvalidated.
provenanceNotes: Aggregation, scale weights, display assumptions, implementation revision, and source-map digests must be retained.

artifactTypes.label: DECOLOR registered video frames
artifactTypes.description: A registered multi-frame image sequence required by canonical DECOLOR and absent from the one-supplied-file product boundary.
sourceNotes: Canonical DECOLOR requires registered video frames; pseudo-frames from transforms are not native evidence.
provenanceNotes: Frame source, order, registration, dimensions, encoding, timestamps, and any synthetic origin must be explicit.

artifactTypes.label: DECOLOR neighborhood graph
artifactTypes.description: The spatial neighborhood graph used to enforce contiguous outlier support over registered frames.
sourceNotes: Neighborhood graph is a distinct DECOLOR input.
provenanceNotes: Spatial/temporal edges, weights, topology, boundary conditions, and frame geometry must be retained.

artifactTypes.label: DECOLOR rank and regularization choices
artifactTypes.description: The low-rank dimensionality policy and sparsity/contiguity regularization parameters.
sourceNotes: Rank and regularization choices are load-bearing DECOLOR inputs.
provenanceNotes: Values, schedules, units, hard/soft conventions, and revision must be pinned.

artifactTypes.label: DECOLOR optimization policy
artifactTypes.description: The initialization, alternating-update, numerical, tie, convergence, and stopping policy for DECOLOR.
sourceNotes: Optimization policy is an explicit DECOLOR input.
provenanceNotes: Initialization, solver revision, precision, tolerances, iteration limit, and stopping rule must be retained.

artifactTypes.label: DECOLOR low-rank background frames
artifactTypes.description: Synthesized low-rank frame reconstructions from the canonical multi-frame decomposition.
sourceNotes: Low-rank background frames are distinct from outlier masks.
provenanceNotes: Background is a matrix-decomposition term only; synthesized frames are not source truth or semantic compositional ground.

artifactTypes.label: DECOLOR contiguous outlier masks
artifactTypes.description: Unlabeled binary supports for spatially contiguous outliers in each registered frame.
sourceNotes: Contiguous outlier masks are explicit DECOLOR outputs.
provenanceNotes: Outlier membership has no field, figure, foreground, identity, or UI-role semantics; frame pairing and binary convention must be retained.

artifactTypes.label: DECOLOR convergence trace
artifactTypes.description: Per-iteration rank, objective, support, residual, and termination observations from DECOLOR optimization.
artifactTypes.intentionalTerminalPurpose: Diagnoses a prohibited canonical multi-frame mechanism and grants no field/figure authority.
sourceNotes: Convergence trace is an explicit DECOLOR output.
provenanceNotes: Must bind frame sequence, graph, parameters, optimizer state, solver revision, and termination.

artifactTypes.label: Scalar image for soft morphology
artifactTypes.description: A scalar image supplied to fixed or learned differentiable soft morphology.
sourceNotes: Scalar image is one of two alternative source forms.
provenanceNotes: Units, range, geometry, validity, and source derivation must be retained; scalar values convey no field role.

artifactTypes.label: Soft mask for soft morphology
artifactTypes.description: A soft mask supplied to fixed or learned differentiable soft morphology without assuming semantic polarity.
sourceNotes: Soft mask is the alternative to a general scalar image.
provenanceNotes: Range, geometry, polarity if any, validity, and source must be retained; no field/figure or role semantics are implied.

artifactTypes.label: Fixed soft-morphology structuring element
artifactTypes.description: A pinned nonlearned structuring-element kernel, origin, support, and boundary convention.
sourceNotes: The fixed-kernel variant is runtime-permitted when kernel and temperature are pinned.
provenanceNotes: Coefficients, shape, scale, origin, normalization, boundary handling, and revision must be retained.

artifactTypes.label: Learned soft-morphology parameters
artifactTypes.description: A learned structuring element or morphology-layer parameter artifact for the prohibited learned variant.
sourceNotes: Learning structuring elements is distinct from a deterministic fixed operator.
provenanceNotes: Weights digest, architecture, training objective/population, source, license, and framework revision are required.

artifactTypes.label: Soft-morphology operator sequence
artifactTypes.description: The ordered erosion, dilation, opening, closing, or loss-producing operation sequence.
sourceNotes: Operator sequence is an explicit differentiable-soft-morphology input.
provenanceNotes: Operation order, repetitions, composition, boundary handling, and output selection must be pinned.

artifactTypes.label: Soft-morphology softness and temperature
artifactTypes.description: The exact smooth-min/max family, softness or temperature values, schedules, and numerical stabilization.
sourceNotes: Softness changes topology and is a load-bearing input.
provenanceNotes: Formula, temperature, schedule, precision, clipping, and stabilization revision must be retained.

artifactTypes.label: Learned soft-morphology training-corpus identity
artifactTypes.description: Conditional governance custody for the population used when the learned-parameter variant is selected.
sourceNotes: Training-population restrictions apply only to the learned variant, not the fixed operator.
provenanceNotes: Dataset/revision, task, population, split, exposure, and license are required when learned parameters are used; no corpus records enter inference.

artifactTypes.label: Soft morphological field
artifactTypes.description: The scalar result of the declared smooth erosion, dilation, opening, closing, or composed morphology operation.
sourceNotes: The same output contract can describe the permitted fixed operator; learned production remains prohibited by mechanism status.
provenanceNotes: Values are morphology-derived evidence and carry no field, figure, role, or identity semantics.

artifactTypes.label: Soft-morphology parameter gradients
artifactTypes.description: Training-time gradients with respect to learned morphology parameters or structuring elements.
artifactTypes.intentionalTerminalPurpose: Training-only gradients for the prohibited learned variant; absent for fixed inference and never a runtime product input.
sourceNotes: Parameter gradients are produced only when training.
provenanceNotes: Loss, batch/corpus, model, operator sequence, temperature, autodiff framework, and precision must be retained.

artifactTypes.label: RGBXY normalized pixel coordinates
artifactTypes.description: Per-pixel normalized X and Y coordinates paired exactly with a source raster geometry.
sourceNotes: Normalized pixel coordinates are a distinct RGBXY decomposition input.
provenanceNotes: Origin, axis direction, pixel-center convention, normalization range, dimensions, and source-raster digest must be retained.

artifactTypes.label: RGBXY palette-size and simplification settings
artifactTypes.description: The requested palette cardinality, hull simplification tolerances, and stopping conditions.
sourceNotes: Palette cardinality and simplification define the RGBXY decomposition.
provenanceNotes: Values, feasibility handling, tie rules, and revision must be pinned.

artifactTypes.label: RGBXY geometric solver policy
artifactTypes.description: The RGB/XY scaling, hull construction, simplification, barycentric solve, numerical, and tie policy.
sourceNotes: Geometric solver policy is an explicit RGBXY input.
provenanceNotes: RGB encoding, coordinate scaling, hull algorithm, precision, tolerances, tie handling, and implementation revision must be retained.

artifactTypes.label: RGBXY palette vertices
artifactTypes.description: A compact set of source-space geometric palette vertices selected from the simplified RGBXY hull.
sourceNotes: Palette vertices are distinct from per-pixel mixing layers.
provenanceNotes: Vertices are decomposition coordinates, not UI role assignments or a complete treatment; observed/synthetic status must be explicit.

artifactTypes.label: RGBXY additive mixing-weight layers
artifactTypes.description: Per-pixel additive weights associated with RGBXY palette vertices for reconstruction and recoloring.
sourceNotes: Mixing-weight layers are an explicit RGBXY output.
provenanceNotes: Layer indices refer only to palette vertices; they are not field, figure, identity, foreground, or UI-role masks.

artifactTypes.label: RGBXY synthesized reconstruction
artifactTypes.description: The image reconstructed from RGBXY palette vertices and additive mixing weights.
artifactTypes.intentionalTerminalPurpose: Reconstruction witness for decomposition diagnosis; synthesized pixels are not exact-source publication or a UI treatment.
sourceNotes: Reconstruction is a distinct RGBXY output.
provenanceNotes: Must bind vertices, layers, raster geometry, color encoding, clipping, rounding, and solver revision.

artifactTypes.label: RGBXY recoloring controls
artifactTypes.description: Controls that replace or transform palette vertices while preserving the computed additive mixing layers.
sourceNotes: Recoloring controls are an explicit output, not an elected treatment.
provenanceNotes: Control domains, vertex mapping, gamut policy, defaults, and revision must be explicit; controls assign no UI roles.

artifactTypes.label: DBNet model-normalized raster
artifactTypes.description: The resized and normalized raster tensor required by the pinned DBNet detector revision.
sourceNotes: DBNet's resized/model-normalized input conflicts with the native-no-resampling boundary.
provenanceNotes: Resize, crop, padding, color conversion, normalization, tensor layout, and native inverse transform must be retained.

artifactTypes.label: DBNet pretrained detector revision
artifactTypes.description: The exact pretrained DBNet/DBNet++ detector weights and architecture revision.
sourceNotes: Pretrained detector revision is an explicit DBNet input.
provenanceNotes: Weights digest, architecture, feature scales, adaptive-fusion revision, source, license, and framework are required.

artifactTypes.label: DBNet binarization thresholds
artifactTypes.description: The differentiable-binarization steepness, score thresholds, and related threshold-map settings.
sourceNotes: Threshold settings are effective DBNet inputs.
provenanceNotes: Values, formulas, inclusivity, scale dependence, calibration, and revision must be pinned.

artifactTypes.label: DBNet polygon postprocessing settings
artifactTypes.description: The contour extraction, unclip, filtering, coordinate projection, simplification, and tie settings.
sourceNotes: Polygon postprocessing is a separate effective DBNet input.
provenanceNotes: Every threshold, geometry convention, clipping rule, ordering, and implementation revision must be pinned.

artifactTypes.label: DBNet scene-text training-corpus identity
artifactTypes.description: Governance custody for the scene-text population and split used to train or calibrate the pinned detector.
sourceNotes: Scene-text population transfer to album typography is an explicit DBNet risk.
provenanceNotes: Dataset/revision, annotation policy, language/script mix, split, augmentations, exposure, and license are required; no corpus records enter inference.

artifactTypes.label: DBNet text probability map
artifactTypes.description: A model-resolution scalar map of learned scene-text region probability.
sourceNotes: Text probability map is distinct from threshold and approximate binary maps.
provenanceNotes: A text score supplies no foreground polarity, identity, UI role, or product-quality authority.

artifactTypes.label: DBNet adaptive threshold map
artifactTypes.description: The learned per-location adaptive threshold map used by differentiable binarization.
sourceNotes: Adaptive threshold map is a distinct DBNet output.
provenanceNotes: Map range, resolution, model head, preprocessing, and projection must be retained; values carry no role semantics.

artifactTypes.label: DBNet approximate binary map
artifactTypes.description: The differentiable approximate binary text-region map derived from probability and adaptive-threshold maps.
sourceNotes: Approximate binary map is separate from hard polygon extraction.
provenanceNotes: Range, steepness, threshold settings, model geometry, and projection must be retained; it is text evidence, not a foreground/role mask.

artifactTypes.label: DBNet text polygons
artifactTypes.description: Postprocessed polygonal regions proposed as scene-text evidence in model or native coordinates.
sourceNotes: Polygons are a distinct postprocessed DBNet output.
provenanceNotes: Coordinate system, projection, scores, contour identity, clipping, and postprocessing revision must be retained; regions carry no UI role or identity authority.

artifactTypes.label: DBNet model and preprocessing provenance
artifactTypes.description: A record of detector, training corpus, preprocessing, thresholds, postprocessing, coordinate projection, and calibration.
artifactTypes.intentionalTerminalPurpose: Audits a prohibited pretrained/resampled text-evidence path and grants no product authority.
sourceNotes: Model/preprocessing provenance is an explicit DBNet output.
provenanceNotes: Must bind exact input and artifact digests without asserting an architecture or producer binding.

artifactTypes.label: Boundary-connectivity image regions
artifactTypes.description: An unlabeled region or superpixel partition of the image domain for boundary-connectivity saliency.
sourceNotes: Image regions/superpixels are a required boundary-connectivity input.
provenanceNotes: Region IDs, complete support, source geometry, and construction scale must be retained; regions carry no field/figure or role labels.

artifactTypes.label: Boundary-connectivity region adjacency
artifactTypes.description: A graph over the supplied regions with stable adjacency identities for saliency propagation.
sourceNotes: Region adjacency is distinct from edge color distances.
provenanceNotes: Graph topology, neighborhood rule, stable region IDs, edge ordering, and source partition must be retained.

artifactTypes.label: Boundary-connectivity region color distances
artifactTypes.description: Declared pairwise color-distance values keyed to edges of the region adjacency graph.
sourceNotes: Color distances are a separate explicit saliency-graph input.
provenanceNotes: Region color statistic, color space, distance formula, edge mapping, scale, and precision must be retained.

artifactTypes.label: Region boundary contacts
artifactTypes.description: Per-region measurements of contact extent with the declared image boundary.
sourceNotes: Boundary contacts are a distinct required input to the background prior.
provenanceNotes: Boundary definition, contact metric, frame handling, region IDs, normalization, and image geometry must be retained.

artifactTypes.label: Boundary-connectivity optimization constants
artifactTypes.description: The background-prior, graph propagation, saliency optimization, numerical, and stopping constants.
sourceNotes: Optimization constants are explicit boundary-connectivity inputs.
provenanceNotes: Every scale, regularizer, transform, solver tolerance, stopping rule, and revision must be pinned.

artifactTypes.label: Region boundary-connectivity scores
artifactTypes.description: Per-region measurements of area-normalized connection strength to the image boundary.
sourceNotes: Boundary-connectivity values are kept distinct from derived background probabilities.
provenanceNotes: Scores encode a geometric prior only and do not establish background, field ownership, or UI role.

artifactTypes.label: Boundary-prior background probabilities
artifactTypes.description: Region-keyed background-prior probabilities derived from boundary connectivity before final saliency optimization.
sourceNotes: Background probabilities are a prior output, not reviewed compositional-ground labels.
provenanceNotes: Probabilities retain region IDs, prior transform, constants, and boundary-contact source; they confer no field or role authority.

artifactTypes.label: Boundary-connectivity optimized saliency map
artifactTypes.description: The optimized image-domain salient-object scalar map after propagating a boundary-background prior over the region graph.
sourceNotes: Optimized saliency map is distinct from boundary connectivity and background-prior probabilities.
provenanceNotes: Saliency is not compositional ground, foreground truth, UI role, identity, or treatment-quality evidence.
